metadata.description: Bundles the preview frame scripts (src/frame/*.entry.ts) into src/lib/generated/frames.ts; commit the result. The engine's tests fail while it is stale.

Bundles the template sandbox's runtime (src/sandbox/entry.ts, plan 27) into dist/packages/engine/sandbox/formfeed-sandbox.js, which the render-worker's isolate and the editor's frame load. Built where it is used, never committed.
